verdict.rationale: Runway's own getting-started guide tells developers to install the official Runway SDK via npm and build against the API (runway-docs-47, runway-docs-10). A live OpenAPI 3.1 spec (runway-docs-6, runway-probe-2) and a documented task-polling model (runway-docs-5) support SDK-based development. Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond the npm package (e.g. Python or other languages), SDK reference or versioning docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
